templates.title: Service positioning balls & needle rollers
templates.description: Maintain the extruder mount positioning balls and extruder positioning plate needle rollers. Follow the model-specific manufacturer procedure.
templates.sourceTitle: How to Maintain the Creator 5 Extruder Positioning Plate Needle Rollers and Extruder Mount Positioning Balls
templates.materials: WD-40, lint-free cloth or wipes, and grease (as specified in the official procedure).
templates.safety: Read the complete official procedure before starting. The manufacturer instructs removal of the PEI plate before this procedure to prevent contamination.
templates.notes: 500 hours is the documented interval. Initial tracking begins at your registration reading; adjust the task baseline if you have a previous service reading.
